name: corvus
description: Corvus — versioned behavior-spec bots on one multiplexed gateway (npm workspaces monorepo)

scripts.typecheck: node -e "var fs=require('fs');var has=false;var ds=fs.readdirSync('.', {withFileTypes: true});for (var i = 0; i < ds.length; i++) { var e = ds[i]; if (e.isDirectory()) { if (e.name === 'apps') { has = true; } if (e.name === 'packages') { has = true; } } } if (has) { process.exit(1); } else { console.log('no workspaces yet, skipping workspace step'); }" || npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.format: prettier --check --ignore-unknown package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc README.md .env.example .nvmrc .github infra .husky && (node -e "var fs=require('fs');var has=false;var ds=fs.readdirSync('.', {withFileTypes: true});for (var i = 0; i < ds.length; i++) { var e = ds[i]; if (e.isDirectory()) { if (e.name === 'apps') { has = true; } if (e.name === 'packages') { has = true; } } } if (has) { process.exit(1); } else { console.log('no workspaces yet, skipping workspace step'); }" || npm run format --workspaces --if-present)
scripts.format:write: prettier --write --ignore-unknown package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc README.md .env.example .nvmrc .github infra .husky
scripts.test: node -e "var fs=require('fs');var has=false;var ds=fs.readdirSync('.', {withFileTypes: true});for (var i = 0; i < ds.length; i++) { var e = ds[i]; if (e.isDirectory()) { if (e.name === 'apps') { has = true; } if (e.name === 'packages') { has = true; } } } if (has) { process.exit(1); } else { console.log('no workspaces yet, skipping workspace step'); }" || npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.ci: npm run build --workspace @corvus/spec && npm run build --workspace @corvus/ai && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format && npm test
